subject.title: [Feature]: Add editable voice dictation to the Control UI composer

question: Should Control UI composer dictation be accepted as a core Gateway/provider-backed feature, or should this work stay paused behind the broader WebChat voice direction?
rationale: The request adds a new user-facing microphone workflow and authenticated Gateway transcription surface, so automation cannot choose the long-term product/security boundary on its own.

options.title: Review the linked Gateway path
options.body: Keep this issue open and decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 after proof, conflict, accessibility, and security-boundary review.

options.title: Fold into broader voice tracking
options.body: Close or pause the linked PR and let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/45508 define the unified WebChat STT/TTS direction first.

options.title: Reject core dictation for now
options.body: Close the issue and PR if maintainers do not want a core composer microphone workflow beyond current Talk and attachment paths.

recommendation.title: Review the linked Gateway path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and decide https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/98027 after proof, conflict, accessibility, and security-boundary review.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest history on the prior server-side dictation slice and the current refactored chat/Gateway surfaces.
